Method of Attack: Exploits two buffer overflows in the ITU T.30 fax protocol components handling DHT and COM markers (CVE-2018-5924 and CVE-2018-5925) to gain remote code execution on fax machines, allowing attackers to run arbitrary code and deploy further exploits such as EternalBlue to compromise nearby devices.
Impacted Systems: HP Officejet all-in-one printers with embedded fax machines
Other fax vendors' devices using the ITU T.30 fax protocol
Attack Vector: Malformed fax images sent via phone lines to the victim's fax number
